source_event.text: I need exactly three cards for a casual round, with one clue every 15 seconds. The six drafts are Black Helmet for Darth Vader, Library Wand for Hermione, Hidden Crown for Black Panther, Precious Riddle for Gollum, Cabbage Cart for the Cabbage Merchant, and Stone Warning for a Weeping Angel. Of our six players, five know Marvel, four each know Harry Potter and Star Wars, three know Lord of the Rings, two know Avatar, and one knows Doctor Who. The guideline favors indirect-to-recognizable clues with a route for non-fans. Library Wand, Hidden Crown, and Precious Riddle follow that progression, though Precious Riddle is tougher. In the small six-person unfamiliar test groups, those cards scored four, four, and three; Black Helmet scored five but its breathing clue seemed obvious early, while Cabbage Cart and Stone Warning scored one each. Which three would work best?
